title: Two Blue Ticks
tagline: Life is full of things we feel but never say.

scenes.vo: Every morning at 6:40, my mother sends me a Good Morning picture. Flowers. A sunrise. Glitter everywhere. For two years… I never replied. Not once.
She learned WhatsApp late. My brother had to teach her twice. Then the pictures started. A rose. A temple. "Have a blessed day" in gold letters.
I'd see them on my way to office, think, "Not again, Mummy," and swipe them away.
Then one winter, I got a high fever. I didn't tell anyone. That morning, her picture came at 6:40, like always. I didn't open it.

scenes.vo: At 7:15, my phone rang. Her voice was shaking. "Your ticks are still grey. Are you okay?"

scenes.vo: That's when I understood. She never wanted a reply. She just wanted two blue ticks… to know I woke up. That I'm fine. That I'm still there.

scenes.vo: Open your mother's good morning today. And reply, just once. Follow Life, Unsaid for more.
